scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Active addresses can be inflated by bots or airdrop farming.
scenes.vo: Address ≠ person: one person can have many addresses; one exchange address serves millions. Transfer ≠ trade: moving tokens isn't buying or selling. Labels are probabilistic: providers guess who owns what; they can be wrong. Active addresses can be inflated by bots or airdrop farming. Data provenance: know chain coverage, indexing method and delay.
